_comment: Facet demo: the IROS demo fleet working the 16-turbine farm, in one sea.
Same fleet as iros_demo/demo_iros.json (59 agents), with:
weather                one sea shared by every xdyn vessel, Beaufort 3 at start, then the force of the Unity wind sliders (follow_wind, 5 s ramps)
(each xdyn evaluates it itself) and the Unity 6 renderer.
wind                   5 m/s from the west (Beaufort 3, the sea's force).
wamv_aisle_*, wamv_fig8_*  full-scale WAM-V 16 on xdyn, WAM-V GNC pipeline
along the IROS paths, three laps, one xdyn process each.
x500_*                 the 15 drones fly on PX4 SITL (px4_offboard_patrol at 1 m/s, one PX4 process each),
so the wind and the wakes push them. Needs a built PX4 checkout, see doc/PX4_DRONES.md.
The Unity 6 player draws the waves and the farm's submarine cables.
Every xdyn agent has its own xdyn_port (12360-12393).
